messages:
zoe: hey folks, first week here! :wave: trying to get the example infra PR to pass. Buildkite job fails when it tries to trigger GH Actions via repo_dispatch — getting 403 Forbidden. snippet:

```
2024-06-14T09:03:12Z ERROR trigger: POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/feature-service/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches 403 Forbidden - resource not accessible by integration
```

Don't want to block bootcamp tasks — anyone know who handles the Buildkite GitHub App permissions? @max?

max: welcome Zoe! :tada: that error almost always means the GitHub App token doesn't have access to that repo (or someone used a user PAT without repo scope). can you paste the pipeline step that does the dispatch?

zoe: here's the block from infra/pipelines/feature-service.yml:

```
- command: |
    curl -s -X POST \
      -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
      -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
      https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/feature-service/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches \
      -d '{"ref":"main"}'
```

zoe: Buildkite injects GITHUB_TOKEN into env.

max: ok. two possibilities: 1) the Buildkite GitHub App is only installed on a subset of repos and feature-service isn't included, or 2) the token is a user PAT with insufficient scopes. ops-bot can check installation quickly.

ops-bot: scanning org installs... Buildkite GitHub App found. Current install type: selected repositories. feature-service not in list. tagging @andre to add the repo.

andre: adding repo now, should be immediate but may take ~30s to propagate. once added you can re-run the job.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/9876 re-run requested by andre

zoe: re-ran and now the dispatch returns 204, GH Actions queued. thanks!! :raised_hands:

max: quick onboarding action items: 1) open a 1-line PR to infra/permissions.md noting that repo dispatch requires the Buildkite app with workflows access; 2) move the curl into scripts/dispatch.sh and log the response code for easier debugging (e.g., `curl -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null`).

zoe: thanks — will do. two quick follow-ups: how do I request ci-admins team access and where is the re-run/artifacts runbook?

andre: request team membership via #people-ops or create a ticket in the org portal. docs live at https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/buildkite-runbook and https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/artifacts.

max: pro tip: if you hit flaky cache failures later, include the build id and `buildkite-agent artifact download` output and tag @eng-infra. we have a short triage checklist.

zoe: super helpful — thanks everyone! i'll update infra docs and ping you on the PR.

andre: welcome aboard! ping me if you want to pair on the infra tasks. :coffee:
